phase-summary.outcome: Completed the first working Payload-backed content authoring vertical slice. The docs-site now has project records, imported canonical schema/pack records, export-to-file behavior, generated Payload types, a created migration, and a content-app workspace that drives the flow end-to-end.

file.description: Registered the new Payload collections in the main docs-site Payload config.
Added project metadata storage for content authoring workspaces.
Added imported canonical schema metadata storage keyed by project and pack.
Added contract-shaped pack document storage keyed by project and pack.
Added the import/export service layer that bridges engine registry definitions to Payload rows and exported JSON files.
Added canonical import route from engine registry into Payload.
Added export route that writes project pack files back out under `docs-site/content-projects/<slug>/`.
Rebuilt the content-app page into a real authoring workspace with project create/save/import/export controls.
Regenerated Payload types so the new collections are first-class typed collection slugs.
Generated a Payload migration for the new authoring collections.
Updated the architecture doc to reflect the implemented Payload-backed authoring baseline and export flow.

commands.command: pnpm --dir docs-site exec payload generate:types --config payload.config.ts

decision.summary: Content authoring is now organized around Payload projects that import engine registry packs and export back to contract-shaped files.
decision.impact: Creates a concrete bridge between DB-backed authoring and file-based runtime consumption without making the engine read arbitrary DB rows directly.

decision.summary: Canonical import uses `CONTENT_PACK_REGISTRY` and engine exports rather than scanning directories or trusting file paths alone.
decision.impact: Keeps the authoring layer aligned to the same contract metadata surface the engine and docs-site registry views already use.

tests.test: pnpm --dir docs-site exec payload generate:types --config payload.config.ts

next.action: Build per-pack CRUD editors on top of the new Payload project model so imported pack documents can be edited in-place instead of only imported and exported.
Connect project export into bundle generation/publish so a validated Payload project can emit `content-pack.bundle.v1.json` without a separate manual path.
